Chapter 508: Chapter 10: Three Treasures (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 508: Chapter 10: Three Treasures (Please Subscribe)

“Over two thousand years old?” Lin Yuan was also carefully observing the black mirror.

Having traversed the Door to the Myriad Realms eight times, he had stayed for twenty years, eighty years, one hundred sixty years, three hundred years, five hundred years, six hundred years, thirty years, and nine hundred twenty years respectively.

Adding up all the stay durations, it amounted to two thousand six hundred ten years, and if the time in the Main World were included as well, Lin Yuan’s precise age would be two thousand six hundred thirty years.

This precise age refers to the age of the Spirit Will, which is the fundamental age for judging a being.

As for the physical age? The soul age? Neither can fundamentally measure the true years a life has experienced.

After all, the body can be changed, the soul can also be abandoned, but only the Spirit Will True Spirit is the core of life.

...

“To so precisely ascertain my true age?” Lin Yuan was somewhat surprised.

When he previously met Xia Qin Supreme Being, the latter had also sensed Lin Yuan’s real age, but not as precisely as this mirror.

Xia Qin Supreme Being had mastered the complete Rule of Time; it was not surprising that he could perceive the true temporal years Lin Yuan had experienced.

But this mirror?

“It must be a treasure involving the Rule of Time,” Lin Yuan guessed to himself.

Time-related treasures, containing the power of time, can only be crafted by those who fully master the Rule of Time.

“How exactly did you practice? In just over two thousand years, not only did you reach the Eighth Layer? But also comprehend so much Cosmic Force?” The Stone Statue Shen Ji couldn’t comprehend, “Could it be you’ve never encountered any bottlenecks or constraints?”

The Stone Statue Shen Ji found it somewhat absurd.

Considering Lin Yuan’s displayed talents, even at the age of four million or five million years, it would be considered incredible. As for just over two thousand years? What can be achieved in just over two thousand years?

Grasping even one type of Cosmic Force?

At this moment, the Stone Statue was full of speculations.

Such as whether the black mirror might be malfunctioning?

Or could Lin Yuan be a legendary Temporal Life?

The former was almost impossible, as the black mirror, crafted by the Moyu Tower Master, contained the complete Rule of Time. Even if there were issues with this test space, it would not malfunction.

And the latter… Temporal Life born within time, living in the River of Time, existing in the past, present, and future. Time could not leave any marks on them, so could that be why they escaped detection by the black mirror?

But even for someone as great as the Demonic Jade Tower Master, Temporal Life was only something he had heard about and never actually seen.

The Stone Statue Shen Ji found it increasingly difficult to understand.

Even if another freak of nature, could they at least conform to some basic logic? Lin Yuan, however, shattered his perceptions in one fell swoop.

What the Stone Statue Shen Ji didn’t know was that the strength at the Eighth Layer and the several types of Cosmic Force were merely a part of Lin Yuan’s achievements over the past two thousand years.

Lin Yuan’s greatest achievement was pioneering the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, where his real efforts lay.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path was Lin Yuan’s strongest confidence in becoming a Supreme Being in the future, whether it was the Space Rules or other laws, or the various Cosmic Forces.

All served the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“Maybe my understanding is a bit higher than others?” Lin Yuan pondered and then said.

“A bit higher?” The Stone Statue Shen Ji remained silent, was it just a bit?

“Alright, I don’t care how you managed to accomplish these things, but with the talents and potential you’ve displayed, you can choose three treasures from all the rewards of the Black Tower’s First Layer and Second Layer,” said Stone Statue Shen Ji.

Those who normally passed the first layer of Magic Jade Tower would receive a random treasure from that level, and these treasures generally ranked in the mid-to-lower tier among all the rewards of the first layer.

Lin Yuan, through the use of dozens of types of Cosmic Force, including Source-level Cosmic Force, demonstrated potential far beyond Stone Statue’s imagination, hence the decision to let Lin Yuan choose any three items from the numerous treasures of the first layer.

Three picks, and of their choice.

No one knew how much stronger this was compared to a random award.

But now.

Upon learning that Lin Yuan was only just over two thousand years old, the Stone Statue expanded the selection change from rewards of the first layer to include those of the second layer as well.

The Demonic Jade Tower Master originally designed this training space so that each layer had its own separate reward treasury; the higher the Black Tower’s levels, the richer and more rare its corresponding reward treasury.

The second layer’s reward treasury was naturally much more superior than that of the first layer’s.

Lin Yuan, having only overcome the first layer yet being allowed to choose rewards including many from the second layer’s treasury, can only imagine the shock in the Statue’s heart.

If it weren’t for the fact that the numerous treasures in the reward treasury of the third layer of the Black Tower were basically useless to Lin Yuan, it might have even opened up the third layer’s treasury for him.

After finishing, Stone Statue Shen Ji raised its right hand, and multiple layers of screens appeared in front of Lin Yuan.

They recorded many treasures and rare items.

“So many treasures?”

Lin Yuan’s heart rate sped up, and the majority of the treasures recorded on the reward list were unheard of by him, but their unparalleled value was confirmed through the remarks and explanations beside each reward item.

In the Main World, they could make those at the Ninth Rank and Tenth Rank break their heads over them.

Even the Origin Fine Gold obtained by Chikun Star Lord at a great expense was only ranked towards the bottom on this list of rewards.

“Too many, too many.”

Lin Yuan reviewed the list several times, finding it difficult to choose, mainly because he had never heard of most of the treasure rewards, although there was a basic remark explaining each item on the list.
